lessons.title: What is a Function?
lessons.content: A function is a reusable block of code designed to perform a specific task. Functions help organize code, reduce repetition, and improve readability.

Scope of Variables
lessons.content: Scope defines where variables are accessible. Variables declared inside a function are local to that function and can't be accessed outside.

Loops Overview
lessons.content: Loops allow running the same block of code multiple times. Common loops include for, while, and do-while loops.
